create_ngram_corpus: create an NgramCorpusFFI instance with capacity, trie depth, BFS breadth, draft token count, and match type
insert_batch_tokens: insert batch token sequences into the ngram corpus using CSR-formatted tensors
match_stateful: match stateful ngram drafts from batch tokens and return matched tokens and masks
load_external_corpus: load an external ngram corpus from token chunks with a named corpus ID and token budget
list_remove_corpora: list all external corpora by ID and token count or remove a named corpus
